rules: Freeze model revision, code commit, dependencies and decoding before opening any report-only test.
Never tune thresholds, prompts, checkpoints or post-processing on a final test.
Score each component independently before running the end-to-end pipeline.
Publish per-dataset results; do not average unrelated domains into one headline score.
Every result must include manifest SHA-256, prediction SHA-256 and model/code provenance.

benchmarks.required_companion: new manually reviewed VieTrans target-domain OCR holdout

benchmarks.reason: The IIMT30K original data were split into train/valid/test; this package uses the held-out test split.
